character.name: Seraphina Vale
character.inventory: Longbow +1, 40 arrows, twin daggers, leather armor, healing potion x2, explorer pack, silver compass, 85 gold

character.description: Once a scout of the Moonwood, Seraphina now tracks the stolen Ember Crown. Her compass points toward ancient ruins, and she suspects the royal advisor is working with a necromancer. She trusts the party but has not revealed that her brother is among the missing.
